title: Grok Had a 'Generation Glitch' That Caused It to Send Users Pure Nonsense - CNET
summary: People who used Grok Lite this week were no doubt surprised when the bot started sending long, large paragraphs of total gibberish. Users reached out to Grok directly to ask what the problem was.
